headline: Dr Arvind Kumar: Air pollution is an existential crisis, serious implementation needed
dek: In a DeKoder Conversations clip, the Medanta chest surgeon urges a change in public attitudes and warns against cosmetic measures and policies that exist only on paper.
body:
Dr Arvind Kumar, Chairman of the Institute of Chest Surgery, Chest Onco-Surgery & Lung Transplantation at Medanta, has described air pollution as an existential crisis for present and future generations, according to a post by DeKoder on X.

The post shares a clip from DeKoder Conversations. It asks whether India is doing enough to tackle air pollution, or whether the country is relying on measures that make little difference on the ground.

According to DeKoder, Dr Kumar urges a change in public attitudes. He also warns against knee-jerk reactions, cosmetic measures and policies that exist only on paper.

DeKoder wrote that, in his argument, what matters is serious implementation that delivers cleaner air. The full conversation is available on DeKoder, the post said.
